verdict.rationale: mParticle documents a real-time API for querying user profiles (docs-4) and a Platform API Audiences endpoint (docs-19), so parts of the story are programmatic. But the only detailed activation doc says connecting an audience to an output is done in the dashboard via Data Platform > Setup > Directory (x2), and the AI audience-building claims (docs-22) are marketing statements, not an agent-facing API. Missing for 10: documented API-driven audience activation/connection without the dashboard, detail on what the Audiences API can create, any MCP server, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an end-to-end agent workflow.
